thread:
Maria (PM): sharing a couple quick mocks — compact invite drawer + a new 'permission lanes' layout for roles matrix. figma: https://figma.redwood/example

Maria (PM): two main concerns i want feedback on: 
1) SSO-enforced orgs — current mock still shows 'invite by email' input. should we hide that and surface a 'copy join link' / 'manage via IdP' flow? 
2) audit log navigation — when you expand a role lane we need a clear jump target so admins can find the related audit entries quickly. keyboard + a11y implications too.

Aj (Designer): +1 on hiding email for SSO enforced orgs. suggestion: replace input with a compact banner that says: "Invites disabled — your org uses SSO" and a CTA: "Copy join link" and a secondary "Manage provisioning" link. 

Aj (Designer): density note for permission lanes: rows feel tight at 12px. increase to 16px, collapse longer role descriptions into a chevron/toggle to avoid verbatim wrapping. also recommend using left-aligned check icons for assignments instead of badges to reduce cognitive weight. :+1:

Samir (Eng): technically fine to hide email input on SSO orgs. we'll need server flag in org settings (sso_enforced=true) and client should fallback to `invite_method=link` UI. for audit logs, prefer a stable anchor id per role e.g. `role-audit-<role_id>` so we can link & scroll-to. performance-wise use cursor pagination for audit entries (infinite scroll + anchors is messy).

Samir (Eng): tiny code note for focus management we should set focus after scroll: 
```
const el = document.getElementById('role-audit-123');
el?.focus(); // ensure keyboard users land on the section
el.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
```

Kelly (Accessibility): overall direction good. a few a11y nits: 
- banner contrast for 'Invites disabled' needs 4.5:1 against background. 
- ensure the copy that replaces the email input is announced to SR users via aria-live="polite" when it appears. 
- keyboard order: from invite drawer close -> banner CTA -> roles matrix should be linear. add a "Skip to audit" link at top of drawer for power users.

Kelly (Accessibility): microcopy tweak suggestion: 
```
Disabled invites — your organization requires Single Sign-On (SSO).
Admins can share this join link with users managed by your identity provider.
[Copy join link] [Manage provisioning]
```

design-bot: accessibility check: color contrast 3.8:1 for current banner text, fails WCAG AA. suggested color: #143E6B on #FFFFFF gives 5.2:1. 

design-bot: layout check: permission lanes collapse state needs an aria-expanded on the lane header and the chevron should be `button` not decorative.

ops-bot: telemetry note — please emit `invite_flow.method` ('email' | 'link' | 'sso_redirect') and `invite_flow.visibility` ('drawer' | 'modal') so we can measure success. also track `audit.jump_source=roles_matrix` when users jump from a lane to audit.

Maria (PM): great, i'll update the figma: hide email input when `sso_enforced`, add banner copy above, add copy-by-default for join link, and add role-audit anchors. assigning tasks: Aj -> final comps + responsive spacing, Samir -> client flag + anchor/focus, Kelly -> final a11y checklist. i'll ping owners in GH after updating. thanks everyone! :sparkles:

Aj (Designer): will post updated comps by EOD.

Samir (Eng): ack, will queue the feature flag work for next sprint.

Kelly (Accessibility): i'll prepare the screenreader test cases and a short checklist for QA.

Maria (PM): closing loop — i'll also add a small tooltip on the roles matrix header: "Permission lanes show granted actions per role — click for audit entries."

Maria (PM): tagging followups: @Aj @Samir @Kelly — reminder to include copy variants for translations (FR/DE/JP) for the banner.
